proposed.name: Gentrification
proposed.line: I see longtime neighbors priced out as my area gets more expensive.

why.detail: In a Texas Lyceum statewide poll, 25% of Texans saw gentrification as a problem where they live, and 60% of those called it a major problem. No national U.S. figure was found.

sources.passage: A new poll released this week by the Texas Lyceum shows that 25% of Texans see gentrification as a problem where they live, with 60% of those saying it is a major problem.

proposed.name: Water pollution
proposed.line: I see our rivers, lakes and drinking water getting polluted.

why.detail: Pollution of drinking water is the top environmental worry in the U.S.: 54% worry a great deal, and 51% about rivers, lakes, and reservoirs (Gallup, 2025). 38% of Europeans name pollution of rivers, lakes and ground water among the most important issues (2020). At least 1.7 billion people use a drinking water source contaminated with faeces (WHO, 2022).

current.name: Opportunity
current.line: I see where you're born decide your life.

proposed.name: Unequal chances

alternatives.name: Unfair start
alternatives.line: I see where someone is born decide how their whole life turns out.

why.detail: "Opportunity" is an area label among problem labels; the line keeps the zip-code idea and makes it something you can picture.

current.name: Discrimination
current.line: I'm treated worse because of who I am.

proposed.name: Discrimination against me
proposed.line: I get treated worse at work, in stores or by landlords because of who I am.

why.detail: Says plainly that it happens to me, and where, so it can't be confused with watching it happen to others (Prejudice).

current.name: Prejudice
current.line: I watch people get treated badly for who they are.

proposed.name: Prejudice around me
proposed.line: I see people around me treated badly because of their race, religion, or who they love.

why.detail: "Discrimination" and "Prejudice" read as synonyms side by side; saying "around me" and naming common reasons makes this the one about others.
